title: "Making Room for Feelings"
description: "Allow a manageable feeling while choosing a useful next step."
sidebar: tool-finder
page-layout: full

Begin with mild discomfort. You can pause, keep your eyes open, or orient to the room. Acceptance of a feeling does not require accepting harm or remaining in danger.

::: {#act-making-room-app .skill-app data-practice-app="act-making-room"}
Loading Making Room for Feelings...
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="A worked example"}
Sam feels disappointed after a cancelled visit. They let themselves acknowledge that disappointment and send a kind message to arrange another time, without first requiring the disappointment to go away.
:::
